def solve(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    from collections import Counter
    # rect color: most common nonzero color
    cnt=Counter(v for r in inp for v in r if v)
    rect=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    rows=[i for i in range(H) if any(v==rect for v in inp[i])]
    cols=[j for j in range(W) if any(inp[i][j]==rect for i in range(H))]
    rmin,rmax,cmin,cmax=min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols)
    ih=iw=rmax-rmin+1-2  # interior rows/cols count
    ih=iw=None
    interior_rows=[i for i in range(rmin+1,rmax)]
    interior_cols=[j for j in range(cmin+1,cmax)]
    ih=len(interior_rows); iw=len(interior_cols)
    out=[[rect]*W for _ in range(H)]
    p=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            v=inp[i][j]
            if v!=rect and not(rmin<=i<=rmax and cmin<=j<=cmax):
                p.append((i,j,v))
    mi=min(x[0] for x in p); mj=min(x[1] for x in p)
    ph=max(x[0] for x in p)-mi+1; pw=max(x[1] for x in p)-mj+1
    P=[[0]*pw for _ in range(ph)]
    for i,j,v in p: P[i-mi][j-mj]=v
    sh,sw=ih//ph,iw//pw
    for bi in range(ph):
        for bj in range(pw):
            v=P[bi][bj]
            if v:
                for di in range(sh):
                    for dj in range(sw):
                        out[interior_rows[bi+di]][interior_cols[bj+dj]]=v
    return out

def solve(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for r in inp for v in r if v)
    rect=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    rows=[i for i in range(H) if sum(1 for v in inp[i] if v==rect)>W//2]
    cols=[j for j in range(W) if any(inp[x][j]==rect for x in range(H))]
    rmin,rmax=min(rows),max(rows); cmin,cmax=min(cols),max(cols)
    ih=rmax-rmin-1; iw=cmax-cmin-1
    p=[(i,j,inp[i][j]) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if inp[i][j] and inp[i][j]!=rect and not(rmin<=i<=rmax and cmin<=j<=cmax)]
    mi=min(x[0] for x in p); mj=min(x[1] for x in p)
    ph=max(x[0] for x in p)-mi+1; pw=max(x[1] for x in p)-mj+1
    P=[[0]*pw for _ in range(ph)]
    for i,j,v in p: P[i-mi][j-mj]=v
    sf_i=ih//ph; sf_j=iw//pw
    out=[[0]*(iw+2) for _ in range(ih+2)]
    for i in range(ih+2):
        for j in range(iw+2):
            if i in(0,ih+1) or j in(0,iw+1): out[i][j]=rect
            else: out[i][j]=0
    for bi in range(ph):
        for bj in range(pw):
            v=P[bi][bj]
            if v:
                for di in range(sf_i):
                    for dj in range(sf_j):
                        out[1+bi*sf_i+di][1+bj*sf_j+dj]=v
    return out
